title: Payment NullPointerException
description: Payment processing fails when the payment object is not initialized before checkout.
root_cause: The payment object is null when the processPayment method attempts to access it.
resolution: Initialize the payment object and validate it before processing the transaction.

title: Login NullPointerException
description: Login fails when the user session object is missing.
root_cause: The application accesses the user session without checking whether the session exists.
resolution: Validate the session object before accessing user information.

title: Order Processing NullPointerException
description: Order creation fails because the customer object is null.
root_cause: The customer object is not initialized before it is used during order creation.
resolution: Validate the customer object before creating the order.

title: Database Connection Failure
description: Application fails while attempting to retrieve data from the database.
root_cause: The database connection is unavailable or incorrectly configured.
resolution: Validate database configuration and connection availability before executing queries.

title: Payment Timeout
description: Payment processing takes too long and the transaction times out.
root_cause: The payment service does not respond within the configured timeout period.
resolution: Increase the appropriate timeout threshold and investigate slow payment-service responses.
